received_works.body:
Shiru-sama, I apologize for bothering you again. I’m sorry for the trouble.
I’ve reviewed the link, so could you please take a look?

I’d like you to write about the two characters in the link!  
They’re a detective duo: the woman is the detective, and the man is her assistant.  

・Female: 150 cm. A carefree young lady who runs a detective agency in the suburbs.
Due to an accident in her childhood, she has a prosthetic leg below the right knee.
She cares deeply for him, and though they’re quite close, they’re not quite a couple yet.   

・Male: 180 cm. He comes across as a frivolous pachinko addict, but deep down he’s serious and harbors one-sided romantic feelings for her, even though he doesn’t want to admit it.
However, because he’s self-restrained and fundamentally serious, he can’t bring himself to make a move. He tends to be at her mercy.   

There’s a height difference of nearly 30 centimeters.  
I’d love a composition where they’re close together and lightly touching each other.  
For their outfits, please feel free to use the ones in the reference materials, modify them, or choose something completely different.   

If there are any issues with the price or missing details, please resend this message. 🙏


https://drive.google.com/file/d/16cU3Vz1c9iQUGjDKi1zx3p1tMS_SGMc6/view?usp=drivesdk
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Nd1nya9vOftZL5_XUQ2YYrrPWG7CGqtm/view?usp=drivesdk
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n7k1Gh9xMdDjt9vosfM0qVFsagzlcpuR/view?usp=drivesdk

https://drive.google.com/file/d/16cU3Vz1c9iQUGjDKi1zx3p1tMS_SGMc6/view?usp=drivesdk

Good evening! Nice to meet you. My name is Kusa, the one who couldn’t become a shrimp.

I was so taken with how cute and wonderful Shiru-san’s illustrations are that I’m reaching out to request an illustration of the TRPG characters my friend and I use. I’ve already gotten my friend’s permission.

The intended uses include: as an icon or header for social media posts (mentioning Shiru-san), sharing with my friend, creating personal merchandise, and providing the illustrations as reference material for future commissions.

The two characters I’d like you to draw are:

A
Name: Asama Kacho
Gender: Female
Age: 28
Height: 219 cm
Personality: Fluffy, laid-back, and incredibly understanding!!!

First-person pronoun: Kacho-chan
How she refers to B: Kishi-chan

She thinks B is cute and tends to want to take care of him.


B
Name: Shippo Kishi
Gender: Male
Age: 26
Height: 159 cm
Hair: Black/Some red
Eyes: Red

Personality: Negative and pessimistic. Utterly pessimistic.
First-person pronoun/Speech: Boku / Desu-masu

In the room, he often stays in the corner so as not to bother his roommate, A.
He is often looked after or has A sit on his lap.

A is often the one clinging to B. B might find this a bit of a hassle.

Feel free to come up with your own scenarios!
You can also change their outfits however you like.


If the payment amount is insufficient, please resend it.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18iGrRUatUt6cma-H7_dUBQdoTXadkcDK

I’d love to see these characters drawn by Shiru-san ❤️
You don’t need to do line art or anything—just draw them casually!
https://photos.app.goo.gl/LoTcNvtRFSyoHsAc6

https://photos.app.goo.gl/LoTcNvtRFSyoHsAc6

Nice to meet you! I’ve been admiring your wonderful illustrations for a while now.
I’d like to request an illustration of my original characters in a “home and away” scenario…! I’d really appreciate it if the theme could be a summer date…!
If anything is missing or unclear, please feel free to resend this request.


① Tsukasa Gyobu
Gender: Male
Height: 179 cm
Age: 25
Occupation: Idol
Personality: The cool, handsome member of an idol group. He harbors a faint crush on the character in ②, but since he has no experience with romance, he gets flustered…


② Suzuri Tokoha
Gender: Female
Height: 188 cm
Age: 27
Occupation: Café employee
Personality: A clumsy older sister type. She’s the “Oh my, oh my” kind of older sister who says, “Let’s not fight!” She prefers conservative clothing (like long skirts).

Their Relationship
A couple with mutual crushes that just won’t seem to progress. Rui is the slightly more assertive one, but since this is her first love, she’s agonizing over every little thing.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AN_tnwQmdb4kti1imQmJBHpHGqFWDAVI

Nice to meet you.
I love the illustrations of men and women that Shiru-san draws, and I really wanted you to draw my two original characters, so I’m placing this commission.

[Character 1]
Gender: Female
Personality: She’s a bit of a mama’s girl and loves to sleep. She also has a mischievous side.
Hairstyle: Long, loose, wavy hair in a natural brown shade that reaches around her shoulder blades.
Eyes: Pale blue-green, slightly drooping eyes.
Mole: One on the left side of her mouth.
Image Color: Pale blue-green

[Character 2]
Gender: Male
Personality: A reliable and kind adult in public, but a super clingy older brother who acts like a big puppy when he’s around the person he likes. He’s very affectionate out of love and often has a doting expression when he’s with his younger sister.
Hairstyle: Black hair, slightly longer with a part slightly toward the center.
Eyes: Deep grayish dark brown, droopy eyes.
Mole: One on the left side of the neck.
Image Color: Milky white

Relationship: Codependent step-siblings.

I would be happy if you could draw them however you like, Shiru-san.

Permitted Uses
・Creating fan art for personal enjoyment
・Using as reference material for future character development

If the details don’t suit you, please feel free to cancel.
I apologize for the inconvenience, but I would appreciate your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H3V8HcjofX8hgFTbO5fNTpJ7XiP0WBTN
